subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2: Climate Change – Writing: Opinion Essay
outcomes: Understand the causes and effects of plastic pollution in the ocean.
Build a paragraph with a topic sentence and supporting sentences.
Plan and write an opinion essay with clear examples and connectors.

tf.s: Plastic ends up in the ocean because it is lightweight and can be blown or washed there.
tf.why: Yes! Wind and water carry light plastic into the sea.

tf.s: In the essay, the writer gives his opinion in the last paragraph only.
tf.why: The writer's opinion is given in paragraph 1.

tf.s: A reusable bottle is a bottle we use many times.
A topic sentence states the main idea of a paragraph.
tf.why: Right, it tells the reader what the paragraph is about.

tf.s: Plastic pollution is dangerous for sea animals but never for people.
tf.why: We may eat plastic when we eat fish that have swallowed it.

tf.s: 'Throw away' means to get rid of something.
tf.why: Well done, it is a phrasal verb.

tf.s: Supporting sentences give examples and details about the main idea.
tf.why: Yes, they make the topic sentence convincing.

tf.s: The introduction of an opinion essay should not include the writer's opinion.
tf.why: The introduction presents the topic and the writer's opinion.
Examples support the opinion and make it more convincing.

tf.s: In 'Plastic is cheap. However, it harms the ocean', 'However' shows contrast.
tf.why: Right, it introduces a different idea.

boxes.q: A bottle we use many times is a ___ bottle.
boxes.why: Reusable means you can use it again.

boxes.q: Which items cause plastic pollution in the essay?
boxes.why: These plastic items end up in the ocean.

boxes.q: Using reusable bottles will ___ in less plastic in the ocean.

o: For example, bottles end up in the sea.
boxes.why: It gives an example to support the main idea.

boxes.q: A good paragraph has a topic sentence and ___ sentences.
boxes.why: Supporting sentences add details and examples.

boxes.q: Plastic is cheap. ___, it harms the ocean.
Sea turtles eat plastic, ___ they are in danger.
After the first draft, we check our work with the ...
boxes.why: The Writing Checklist helps us edit.

boxes.q: What goes in the introduction of an opinion essay?
o: the topic and the writer's opinion
boxes.why: The reader learns your view from the start.

boxes.q: Why do people use plastic so much?
boxes.why: Plastic is easy and convenient to use.

hunt.q: Used only once, then thrown away

mcq.q: Why does plastic end up in the ocean?
o: It is lightweight, so wind and water carry it there.
People throw it into rivers on purpose only.
It is made in the ocean.
mcq.why: Light plastic is easily blown or washed away.

o: the sentence that states the main idea of the paragraph
the last word of the essay
a sentence with an example only
mcq.why: It usually comes first in the paragraph.

mcq.q: In which paragraph is the writer's opinion given?
mcq.why: The opinion is in the introduction.
We throw away things we don't want.

mcq.q: Choose the best topic sentence about reducing plastic.
o: Reducing the amount of plastic we use can protect the ocean.
For example, I have a bottle.
mcq.why: It gives a clear main idea.

mcq.q: Choose the best topic sentence about plastic bags.
o: Using fewer plastic bags helps the environment.
mcq.why: It states a clear opinion about the topic.

mcq.q: Join with a connector: 'Plastic ends up in the sea. Fish swallow it.'
o: Plastic ends up in the sea; therefore, fish swallow it.
Plastic ends up in the sea because of fish swallow it.
Due to fish, plastic ends up.

mcq.q: Why is plastic pollution dangerous for people?
o: We may eat plastic when we eat fish that swallowed it.
mcq.why: Plastic can enter our food through fish.

mcq.q: How does an example support a topic sentence?
o: It shows the idea with a real case, so it is more convincing.
mcq.why: Real cases make your point stronger.

mcq.q: Which is the correct order of an opinion essay?
mcq.why: This order makes the essay clear and logical.
